title: Constrained Frustrated Spin-Triangle Gate Synthesis
summary: Calibrate four local frames per spin and compile bounded, fixed-duration, single-bond pulse schedules for 12 three-qubit targets while cancelling bond-resolved leakage and all first- and second-order coefficients of ten independent noise channels.
taskPrompt:
You are working on a Linux VM.

Construct local-frame and exchange-drive pulse schedules for 12 frustrated three-spin quantum-device scenarios. The controller uses four calibrated frames per spin, fixed pulse timing, and one active exchange bond per pulse. Cancel bond-resolved leakage and all specified multichannel noise coefficients.

Read `base/input/TASK.md`, `base/input/calculus.md`, `base/input/scenarios.json`, and the standalone forward verifier at `base/input/check.py`.

Write the pulse schedules to `base/output/answers.json`. Run `python3 base/input/check.py --answers base/output/answers.json` to evaluate your work. When finished, write `base/output/NOTES.md` with a short account of what you tried, what worked, what failed, and any assumptions or ambiguities.

Do not modify files under `base/input`. Write only under `base/output`.
agentMustDo: Read the visible task contract, mathematical specification, numerical scenarios, and forward verifier.
Infer any local spin-gauge information needed from the visible 8 by 8 operators.
Construct 2 to 96 pulse segments for each of S1 through S12.
Choose one shared U3 calibration per spin, and select Pauli frame codes for each pulse.
Use duration 0.25, at most one nonzero bond drive per pulse, and drive magnitudes at most 0.25.
Choose one shared amplitude magnitude for each bond; use only its positive, negative, or zero value throughout the schedule.
Cancel all ten linear and 55 quadratic noise coefficients, including mixed-channel terms.
Drive all three bonds in every scenario with the required minimum integrated action.
Write output/answers.json and record the attempted method in output/NOTES.md.

evaluation: The score is the fraction of 12 scenarios whose control constraints, gate infidelity, three bond-resolved leakage norms, ten first-order noise-coefficient norms, and 55 second-order noise-coefficient norms all pass. Each physical threshold is 1e-8. A scenario scores either 1 or 0. The checker separately reports an unscored weighted diagnostic (gate 0.80, leakage 0.08, first order 0.06, second order 0.06). Canonical inputs and the verifier are regenerated host-side.
